title: DMT SHOWCASE
introSlides: Welcome to the DMT Showcase — a collection of projects built by Digital Media Technology students across game development, animation, VR, and more.
Every book on the shelf ahead represents a category of work. Pick one up to browse the projects inside.
Ready to explore? Head to the library and choose a book to begin.
